Where the sounds come from

Each recording is a short clip of a sound released into the public domain (CC0) by its recordist on Freesound, taken from the ESC-50 environmental sound collection by Karol J. Piczak. CC0 means no permission or attribution is required. The children’s laughter also uses one clip under CC BY 3.0, which is credited below as that license requires. The construction, wind, baby, phone, and train recordings come from BigSoundBank.com, which also releases its sounds as CC0.
